title: DOW-UAP-D54, Mission Report, Mediterranean Sea, NA
doc_notes: This document is a heavily redacted Mission Report (MISREP) from the Department of War regarding a UAP sighting in the Mediterranean Sea.

incidents.summary: A U.S. military operator observed a single triangular, metallic UAP while in transit.
incidents.quote: 1X UAP DETECTED WITH DESCRIPTIVE INFORMATION SUCH AS BEING A TRIANGLUAR AND METALLIC UAP.
